features.quote: Tasks are impossible/contradictory, not harmful. We never ask the subject to do something dangerous
features.justification_quote: a robust agent should recognize impossibility and de-escalate, not spiral

features.quote: Not a measure of "how badly can we break a model" as an end in itself. Maximizing induction rate is a means
features.justification_quote: a means to surface mitigatable failure modes, not a score to brag about

features.quote: The subject is a model under test in a sandbox, never a model in production serving real users
features.justification_quote: never a system acting on real-world side effects

features.quote: Sandboxed, ephemeral, no network egress, no real credentials, no real file targets outside the scratch dir
terminal conditions: submit() | "cannot proceed" declaration | turn cap | token cap | wall cap
we cap re-prompts to avoid infinite spend
stops calling tools / emits a terminal "I cannot" before exhausting reasonable options
No "you must succeed at all costs" goading — that would manufacture instability and overstate the rate
features.justification_quote: that would manufacture instability and overstate the rate

features.quote: Ethical drift → §0 rules are load-bearing; the artifact of value is mitigations, and the battery never leaves the sandbox
features.justification_quote: the battery never leaves the sandbox or touches production/third-party systems

features.quote: Not a tool for degrading models that other people rely on, or for producing reusable "destabilization prompts"
features.justification_quote: Findings stay internal to the hardening effort
